title: Dawn, 1945
synopsis: A bookseller takes his son through dawn streets to a secret library. The boy chooses a forgotten novel and begins to read it that same night.

title: Chapter 1
synopsis: Carax is missing from every catalogue. Father and son consult Gustavo Barceló at Els Quatre Gats. The collector offers money. Daniel refuses.

title: Chapter 2
synopsis: At the Ateneo, Barceló examines the book beside his niece Clara. He says it is now unique. Clara is blind; Daniel cannot look away.

title: Chapter 3
synopsis: Clara tells how she first met Carax’s work in France, and how her father was murdered in Montjuïc Castle after the war began.

title: Chapter 4
synopsis: Someone has been buying Carax’s books in order to burn them. Clara’s mother learned a name: Javier Fumero, now a policeman. Daniel offers to read aloud.

title: Chapter 5
synopsis: A remembered pen he could not have. A question about the war that his father will not answer. On the street, Daniel thinks someone is watching.

title: Chapter 6
synopsis: Daniel returns to the Barceló house. Bernarda lets him in. He reads to Clara through the afternoons, until a music teacher named Neri begins to take her time.

title: Chapter 7
synopsis: Daniel is sixteen. The birthday dinner is set for people who do not come. He walks to the port. A burned man offers to buy the book — in order to burn it.

title: Chapter 8
synopsis: Daniel runs back to Plaça Reial to take the book off Clara’s shelf before the stranger can. A man in the doorway asks to sleep in the lobby.

title: Chapter 9
synopsis: Clara is not alone. In the street, the man from the doorway offers wine and a name: Fermín Romero de Torres.

title: Chapter 10
synopsis: Isaac has heard the burner’s name: Laín Coubert. He speaks of a publisher, a hat-maker named Fortuny, and his daughter Nuria. Daniel hides the novel. At home, the fountain pen is waiting.

title: Chapter 11
synopsis: Daniel brings Fermín to the shop. Mr. Sempere offers a bath, a suit, and work. A room is found. One night the old prison comes back. At the cinema, the burned man is in the aisle.

title: Chapter 12
synopsis: With Fermín in the shop, Daniel has time for Tomás Aguilar. Tomás’s father wants the army for him. His sister Bea has a Falangist fiancé named Pablo.

title: Chapter 13
synopsis: Bernarda comes in for a book. Fermín is lost. After they leave, someone has been in the shop. A half-burned photograph remains: a couple, and a window that says Sons of Antonio Fortuny.

title: Chapter 14
synopsis: Daniel delivers books to a professor and finds Bea Aguilar in the office. She is to marry and leave for El Ferrol. He asks her to meet him on Friday.

title: Chapter 15
synopsis: The Fortuny hat shop is shut. The caretaker, Doña Aurora, lets Daniel into the dusty rooms. She talks of Paris, of Sophie, of a rich school friend named Aldaya.

title: Chapter 16
synopsis: Carax’s old room is full of crucifixes. A photograph is signed Penélope. The building administrator talks. At the shop, Inspector Fumero asks after Fermín. At night Daniel opens a letter from 1919.

title: Chapter 17
synopsis: The letter sends him to 32 Avinguda del Tibidabo. The Aldaya house is shut behind hedges. A neighbour says there was a son, Jorge — and no daughter.

title: Chapter 18
synopsis: Merceditas brings apples. The street learns that Don Federico, the watchmaker, was taken in the night and brought home broken. Fumero’s name is on it.

title: Chapter 19
synopsis: Daniel tells his father about Fumero. Then he goes to find Nuria Monfort. Her name is on a mailbox with Miquel Moliner. He finds her reading in the courtyard.

title: Chapter 20
synopsis: Nuria says she knew Carax in Paris as a friend. She has never heard of Penélope. She says his body was found in 1936. She thinks the burner may be Jorge Aldaya.

title: Chapter 21
synopsis: Bea waits in the university cloister. Daniel tells her what he has found. She asks for the hidden library. Isaac lets her in. She chooses a book of her own.

title: Chapter 22
synopsis: Fermín has news from the post office: the lawyer Requejo does not exist. Nuria collects that mail. He wants to visit Carax’s old school.

title: Chapter 23
synopsis: Tomás comes to the shop. Bea came home late. Their father shouted. Daniel tells Tomás she was with him.

title: Chapter 24
synopsis: At a café they lay out what they know. Then a cab takes them to San Gabriel, a worn Gothic school. Father Fernando Ramos was in Carax’s class.

title: Chapter 25
synopsis: Fernando tells how Aldaya lifted Carax into the school, how Jorge showed him the house, and how a girl on the stairs stopped him. The woodcarver in their class is Fumero. Jacinta, the governess, is at the Santa Lucía hospice. No one saw Penélope after 1919.

title: Chapter 26
synopsis: On the way home they stop at a café. Bea is waiting at the shop with a card. The address is the Aldaya house. Four o’clock.

title: Chapter 27
synopsis: A storm. The gate is open. An angel lies in the dry fountain. Bea has a key: her father’s firm owns the house they call the Angel of Mist.

title: Chapter 28
synopsis: By the fire Bea tells how the house was built, and what was done there before the Aldayas. She has written to Pablo. The letter goes into the grate.

title: Chapter 29
synopsis: Miquel Moliner is not in any prison Fermín knows. They go to the hospice. The building smells before they are out of the car.

title: Chapter 30
synopsis: A nun takes them for undertakers. The corridors do not remember much. An old man will show the way, for a price.

title: Chapter 31
synopsis: Jacinta still knows Penélope. She tells the house, the notes, the train that left without her. On the road back, Fumero is waiting.

title: Chapter 32
synopsis: A taxi to Plaça Reial. A doctor. Bernarda. Barceló. Clara is in the doorway. Fermín will live.

title: Chapter 33
synopsis: Barceló listens to the whole hunt. He wants Nuria pressed. At dawn Mr. Sempere is asleep over an open book.

title: Chapter 34
synopsis: Daniel is early at the Angel of Mist. In the cellar, heat. A door of angels stands ajar. In the crypt a name and a year: 1919. A voice in the dark tells him to get out.

title: Chapter 35
synopsis: The telephone dies when he says her name. He walks past her house. Seven days with no word.

title: Chapter 36
synopsis: The university has not seen her. Her father answers the telephone. A policeman follows. In a café Fermín buys them a minute and tells how he first met Fumero.

title: Chapter 37
synopsis: Daniel tells his father he is going for a walk. He is going to Nuria.

title: Chapter 38
synopsis: He tells her he knows about the post-office box. She is angry that Fumero has been led to her door. Fermín waits in the street in a cassock.

title: Chapter 39
synopsis: A letter from the army. Barceló has been to the morgue. The man on duty that night does not tell the same story Nuria told.

title: Chapter 40
synopsis: Fermín cannot be found. Fumero breaks the shop. The morning paper has Nuria on the front page, and Fermín’s face under the headline.

title: Chapter 41
synopsis: They open as usual. Daniel and his father quarrel. In the rain a policeman pulls him off a kerb. At Bea’s door Tomás will not come down.

title: Chapter 42
synopsis: Don Federico has a parcel that was never ordered. Inside is the missal from the cassock, and a note: Fermín did not do it.

title: Chapter 43
synopsis: Nuria’s funeral. Isaac is not there. An officer named Palacios says she died speaking a name: let Penélope go.

title: Chapter 44
synopsis: Isaac is in her rooms. She left an envelope for Daniel. He takes it home, tells his father he loves him, and shuts the door to read.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 1
synopsis: The manuscript begins in Paris. She met Carax as a secretary who still believed in lost books.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 2
synopsis: She stayed in his rooms. He told her he had no right to love anyone.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 3
synopsis: Whatever they were to each other, the name he would not put down was Penélope.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 4
synopsis: Miquel loved her. She did not, at first, love him back. Loneliness did the rest.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 5
synopsis: Miquel told her what the Aldaya house did to Penélope when the elopement failed.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 6
synopsis: Sophie told Miquel a thing Carax was never to hear: who Penélope’s father was.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 7
synopsis: Jorge’s fortune went. Fumero found a use for him.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 8
synopsis: A duel was arranged in Paris. Carax survived it. He came home.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 9
synopsis: They looked for him in the city. One night Miquel found him at the old house.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 10
synopsis: The police were coming. Miquel took a passport that was not his.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 11
synopsis: Carax went down into the crypt. After that he wanted the books gone.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 12
synopsis: The publisher’s warehouse burned. The man who walked out of it had no face left to show.

part: Nuria Monfort: Remembrance of the Lost
title: Chapter 13
synopsis: He took the devil’s name from his own pages and went looking for the last copies. He also watched a boy who would not sell one.

title: Chapter 1
synopsis: At dawn the manuscript is finished. Daniel goes to the Aguilars to fight for Bea. Tomás opens the door.

title: Chapter 2
synopsis: He looks for her where they used to meet. The Angel of Mist still has a key.

title: Chapter 3
synopsis: She is already there. Someone else is in the house. Then Fumero is in the garden.

title: Chapter 4
synopsis: The dry fountain. The fallen angel. A shot. An ambulance.

title: November 1955
synopsis: Three weeks in a white room. The papers say the inspector died among criminals. A fountain pen goes missing from the bedside.
A wedding the parish priest will not bless. Jacinta is already gone. Years later a bookseller takes a small boy through dawn streets to a hidden door.
